title: in my uncle era @Sesame Street the Musical #sesamestreet #broadway #nyc
transcript: Hi out there. It's me, Callum. Come with me and Uncle Tyler see Sesame Street the Musical. Uncle Tyler loves merch, and so do I, so he got me a shirt. I've never been to a show in NYC before, so when I walked into the theater, it was like YouTube in real life. Mom and dad read Sesame Street the musical. The show started, and I was shocked. Then I was so happy. Bubbles, I need this for my room. Who was happier, me or Uncle Tyler? Elmo came out to say goodbye, and I was so happy to see Elmo. He told me he loves me. But then it was over, and I was sad. What do you mean? We have to go home now. Stop waving by. But Uncle Tyler had more fun planned. We get to go on stage and meet the cast. They kept trying to get me to look at the camera, but I just wanted to look at my new friends. Thank you, Uncle Tyler, for taking me to my first musical. I love my merch. I give the show two hands up. Until next time. This is Callum signing out.
